## App work and recovery report (required)

Follow `APP_CHANGE_AND_RECOVERY_RULE.md`. Update `APP_WORK_REPORT.md` for every app work delivery.

- What changed, distinguishing new repairs from existing features reused:
- How it was implemented and exact files/commit:
- Where to see/use it:
- Tests run and observed results:
- Committed / built / browser-tested / visually checked / deployed status:
- Failures, limitations and unfinished work:
- If broken: symptom, likely cause, diagnostic command, minimal repair and safe rollback:
- Learner data and existing owners protected:
- Next action and acceptance criteria:

Do not claim a build pass proves successful use. Do not reset learner data to fix appearance or navigation. Link the current report in the delivery response.
